title: Run Vision Observation over an authorized accepted photo
verify: The canonical vision_observation definition permits only speak, clarify, or strict model silence and cannot diagnose, recommend physical action, or widen the roster/provider policy.

The assembler resolves current ActorContext for the same active Plant, loads one accepted catalog row, contains its relative path under LOCAL_ARTIFACT_ROOT, and freshly verifies content type, size, and sha256 before provider I/O.

The provider receives the exact ordered VisionProviderRequestV1 plus one in-memory image matching photo:<photo_id>; no local path, filename, ActorContext, auth material, UI/chat, timeline replay, or arbitrary metadata crosses egress.

Vision v1 accepts only an explicit Gemini binding and image-capable model id; DeepSeek, chatgpt_oauth, disabled egress, missing credential/dependency, provider failure, and incompatible model fail closed without fake or fallback output.

Strict result validation preserves the canonical matrix: speak maps one supported visible finding to a pending non-consumable MessageEnvelope plus VisionStateCandidateV1; clarify maps to a pending clarification envelope without candidate; silent returns neither artifact. For speak, low-confidence/uncertain findings use a hypothesis envelope claim only as transport metadata and TASK-035 persists them exactly as unknown, with no direct DB/Bus/UI/task/Safety effect here.

Missing or unavailable photo data returns context_denied/input_contract_violation before provider and runtime-audit I/O, with no clarification envelope, state candidate, or follow-up task; FT-016 may render an upload/reselect prompt and FT-012 owns any later follow-up task.
Post-model session/membership/grant/active-Plant guard and audit failure semantics match Agent Runtime; archive/revoke blocks handoff and restore does not replay it.

A non-skipped credentialed canonical-agent smoke uploads the committed tomato fixture through production photo intake, invokes exactly one real Gemini image call over the accepted bytes, and returns runtime_decision=speak with audited envelope_ready, one valid pending MessageEnvelope, and one matching VisionStateCandidateV1. Clarify remains envelope-only and silent returns neither artifact; neither satisfies this fixture. Evidence remains redacted and safe.

purpose: Add the canonical Vision Observation product-agent path that sends one authorized accepted local photo to one explicitly configured real image-capable model while preserving project authorization, privacy, audit, and pending-only authority boundaries.
success_outcome: Actual bytes from an authorized accepted Plant photo reach exactly one explicitly bound real Gemini vision model, and the committed tomato fixture yields runtime_decision=speak with audited envelope_ready, one schema-valid pending MessageEnvelope, and one matching VisionStateCandidateV1. Clarify produces only its envelope and silent produces neither artifact, so both fail this fixture acceptance alongside every invalid, unauthorized, archived, unconfigured, fake, failed, fallback, or unaudited path; no branch gains Plant-state, Bus, UI, task, Safety, or confirmation effect.

constraints: Use exactly one internally assembled active-Plant plus accepted-photo request and one freshly verified in-memory media attachment; callers cannot submit context, refs, bytes, path, prompt, model, or schema.
Version-1 vision execution uses only the explicitly bound Gemini profile/model and the existing credential/egress boundary with no fallback.

Preserve the exact result matrix: speak returns pending MessageEnvelope plus non-authoritative VisionStateCandidateV1, clarify returns only its pending envelope, and silent returns neither; persist or publish nothing from this task.
invariants: Photo/catalog/runtime authority remains local and authorized; provider input omits local paths, identity/session/grant state, secrets, UI/chat, timeline replay, and hidden reasoning.
Agent output can observe or hypothesize but cannot diagnose, recommend physical action, confirm Plant state, or gain publication/Safety/task authority.
Archive/revoke/audit failure after model I/O blocks handoff and restore never replays it.
verification_targets: The credentialed committed-tomato-fixture smoke proves a real Gemini image call, runtime_decision=speak, one pending MessageEnvelope plus one matching VisionStateCandidateV1, and redacted evidence; clarify and silent fail fixture acceptance.
